parameters.content:
## WF5: Edinburgh Local Event Scout

🎯 **Purpose:** Acts as your automated marketing researcher — finds local events that drive short-stay demand in Edinburgh, so you can adjust pricing or launch promotions ahead of time.

🔄 **Runs:** Every Monday at 9:00 AM automatically

✅ **What's been FIXED in this version:**
• Added duplicate detection — won't log the same event twice
• Added owner Telegram alert when new events are found
• Improved search query for better results

⏰ **Weekly Schedule Trigger**
Fires automatically every Monday morning at 9:00 AM.
💡 Starts the event scouting process at the beginning of each week so you have time to adjust pricing before the weekend.

🔍 **Tavily AI Web Search**
Searches the internet for confirmed upcoming events in Edinburgh (concerts, festivals, sports matches) for the next 4 weeks.
💡 Tavily is an AI-powered search engine that returns structured results — much more reliable than raw Google scraping.

parameters.query: upcoming local events concerts festivals sports matches in Edinburgh next 4 weeks

nodes.name: 🔍 Search Edinburgh Events via Tavily AI

parameters.content:
✂️ **Split Search Results**
The Tavily search returns a single bundle of results. This node splits them into individual items so each can be processed separately by the AI in the next step.
💡 Required to let the AI analyse each search result one by one.

🧠 **AI Event Extractor (Groq LLM)**
Sends each search result to the Groq AI (Llama 3.3 70B). The AI reads the web content and extracts structured event data (Name, Date, Venue, Link).
💡 AI rules out vague listings and only keeps confirmed events with real dates and venues.

parameters.text:
=You are a data extraction assistant. I will provide you with web search results for upcoming events in Edinburgh. Your job is to extract specific, confirmed events (e.g., specific concerts, sports matches, or festivals).

STRICT RULES:

Ignore generic event directories or aggregate pages.

Ignore any event where the date or venue is "TBD" or unknown.

You must output ONLY a valid JSON array of objects.

Each object MUST have exactly these four keys to match my database: "Event Name", "Date", "Venue", and "Link".
title:{{ $json.results.title }}
content:{{ $json.results.content }}

parameters.content:
🔧 **JSON Cleaner & Combiner**
The AI sometimes wraps JSON in markdown code blocks (```json ... ```). This node strips those out and combines all extracted events from all search results into a single clean list.
💡 Handles AI formatting errors gracefully — bad outputs are skipped, good ones are kept.

📋 **Read Existing Events (for Duplicate Check)**
[NEW] Reads all events already stored in the Edinburgh Events Google Sheet.
💡 This data is used in the next step to prevent the same event being logged every week. Without this, duplicates would pile up in the sheet.

nodes.name: 📋 Read Existing Events from Edinburgh DB

parameters.content:
🔍 **Duplicate Filter**
[NEW] Compares newly found events against what's already in the database. Matches on Event Name + Date combination.
💡 If an event is already in the sheet, it's skipped. Only genuinely new events pass through. Returns a special 'noNewEvents' flag if nothing new was found.

❓ **New Events Gate**
[NEW] Checks if any genuinely new events were found this week.
💡 If there's nothing new (all events already in the DB), the workflow stops here to avoid sending an empty Telegram alert or logging duplicate rows.

nodes.name: ❓ Are There New Events This Week?

parameters.content:
💾 **Save New Events to Sheet**
Appends each new event (Name, Date, Venue, Link) as a new row in the Edinburgh Events Google Sheet.
💡 This serves as the permanent record of all discovered events. The duplicate filter above reads from this same sheet next week.

nodes.name: 💾 Save New Events to Edinburgh DB

parameters.content:
✍️ **Build Telegram Summary**
[NEW] Formats all newly found events into a clean, readable Telegram message with event name, date, and venue listed.
💡 Aggregates all items into a single message so the owner gets one neat summary, not multiple individual pings.

📱 **Owner Telegram Alert**
[NEW] Sends the formatted event summary to the owner's Telegram.
💡 Owner receives this every Monday when new events are found. The message suggests considering pricing adjustments or promotions to capture demand from event attendees.

nodes.name: 📱 Alert Owner via Telegram — New Events Found

parameters.content:
📌 **Merge (Wait)**
Waits for both the AI extraction and the DB read to finish before letting the Filter node run.
